LearningMemory already owns immutable Song/Session-bound episodes, append-only observed consequences with source/confidence/conditions/confounders, one terminal KEEP/REVERT/REVISE/INCONCLUSIVE decision, and canonical Activity events.

The missing customer seam is using that model during real Song work: record a concrete change, record what was observed afterward, then decide what to do without claiming the change caused the observation.

New Learning episodes in this increment must bind the exact active Song and exact open work Session. Existing undecided episodes may remain inspectable and completable across navigation/relaunch even after their Session closes.

A terminal decision requires at least one consequence, explicit rationale and confidence. Decision authority must bind the exact rendered consequence state so an older page cannot decide without seeing a newer observation.
Learning history remains append-only. A decided episode cannot receive another consequence or another decision.
